title: deny_commands and the writer lease miss a command that is not first in a naive split
detail: _command_denied and _shared_tree_git_mutation split on ; && || | newline and compare the first tokens, so '(git push)', 'if git push; then x; fi', '>o git push', 'X=1 git push', '! git push', '{ git push; }' and 'case x in x) git push;; esac' all pass both a phase deny and the shared-tree lease check. Measured on 0.238.2. They should read statements through _command_starts, the one source of command position, once fb-961eaed62314 lands.
